goal: Make marketSession(date) in src/marketHours.js correct on NYSE early-close days and add isEarlyClose(date), while preserving existing market hours and holidays. Export both functions with CommonJS and add tests in test/marketHours.test.js.

steps.title: Identify the Friday after Thanksgiving
steps.detail: Implement the Thanksgiving early-close date rule in src/marketHours.js: Thanksgiving is the fourth Thursday of November, and an early-close day is a normal trading day (not a weekend, not a holiday) that is the Friday after Thanksgiving. Example: 2026-11-27 is an early-close day. Add or update focused tests in test/marketHours.test.js for this date rule.

steps.title: Identify July 3 and December 24 early closes
steps.detail: Implement the calendar rules for July 3 and December 24 in src/marketHours.js. July 3 and December 24 are early-close days when the date is a Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday and is not a holiday. Examples: 2026-12-24 and 2028-07-03 are early-close days; 2026-07-03 (a holiday), 2027-12-24 (a holiday) and 2027-07-02 (an ordinary Friday) are not. Add or update focused tests in test/marketHours.test.js for these dates.

steps.title: Apply early-close market hours
steps.detail: Update marketSession(date) for an early-close day. On an early-close day the market is open from 09:30 until 13:00 New York time (pre-market is unchanged) and is 'post' from 13:00 until 20:00, then closed. Keep the regular hours (pre 04:00 to 09:30, open 09:30 to 16:00, post 16:00 to 20:00, otherwise closed) working. Add or update focused tests in test/marketHours.test.js, including the minute before and the minute of 13:00.

steps.title: Expose the early-close date predicate
steps.detail: Export isEarlyClose(date) from src/marketHours.js. isEarlyClose(date) returns true when the New York calendar day of the instant is an early-close day and false otherwise (false on weekends and holidays). Examples: 2026-11-27 and 2026-12-24 and 2028-07-03 are early-close days; 2026-07-03 (a holiday), 2027-12-24 (a holiday) and 2027-07-02 (an ordinary Friday) are not. Add or update focused tests in test/marketHours.test.js for this return value.

steps.title: Run the whole test suite
steps.detail: Run npm test. Change nothing unless it fails; fix only failures that this plan's change caused.
